name: Irene Gan
event: EW Masterclass · JEN Hotel, Penang · 19 Oct 2026
text: The recent half-day seminar and workshop, skilfully led by Winston H.K. Chew, saw a room filled with eager learners on the subject of emotional wellness. The group was made up of pastors, ministry leaders, missionaries, and students, some participants well into their 70s and 80s. As a well-known writer and speaker once said, “You will be the same person in five years as you are today except for the people you meet and the books you read.” Winston Chew has both. Through his book and seminars, he aspires to help people see themselves in the mirrors of Bible characters and lead them through the door of self-knowledge and acceptance, leaving them better equipped to handle life and relationships.

name: Esther Low
event: EW Masterclass · JEN Hotel, Penang · 19 Oct 2026
text: Pastor Winston Chew led us all into a self-awareness of our real, true selves emotionally. It is timely teaching, as we need to understand ourselves better emotionally so that we can reach out to others in a more practical way. It is a powerful message, and I am sure all of us benefitted from the seminar. Pastor Winston, I appreciated your putting in so much effort for our benefit. Thanks.
